description: This file serves as the server entry point for a Remix.js web application, handling HTTP requests by rendering React components and managing streaming responses based on user-agent detection.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main entry function to process incoming HTTP requests, set headers, and delegate to bot or browser-specific handlers.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for bot user agents, streaming the React app as a server side rendered HTML response.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for browser user agents, streaming the React app as a server side rendered HTML response.
